This is not a traditional development-only role. You will contribute across both software development and product management, helping complete an MVP, launch the product, and iterate toward product-market fit. At Lucra Tax, we believe the best developers understand users-their needs, pain points, and what makes a product truly valuable. You will work closely with an experienced founding team and gain exposure to the full lifecycle of an early-stage software startup. What you'll do Primary Responsibilities: • Develop and ship new product features across the full stack Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve bugs and performance issues in both frontend and backend systems • Additional Responsibilities: • Build and enhance a consumer web application and a complementary mobile application • Participate in product discovery and product management activities • Help complete and launch the MVP and support post-launch iteration • Participate in user walkthroughs and feedback sessions • Use system monitoring, tracing, and user replays to identify usability and performance issues • Write unit tests and end-to-end (E2E) tests • Work within agile development processes • Contribute to an AI-powered platform that automates tax preparation and tax consulting, including prompt engineering and the design of AI-assisted workflows • Support roadmap initiatives including: • A mobile app for capturing photos of receipts Gmail integrations and applications • Technology Stack • Typescript • SvelteKit • Drizzle ORM • PostgreSQL • Playwright (BDD) • Cucumber (unit testing) • OpenAI APIs • Lightdash (reporting) • Cloudflare • Claude Code Cursor • Job
